name: Pad Colors
author: maximevincentclaudeai
summary: Choose the color of the performance pads and the pad-mode buttons from the Mod Menu.
description:
Recolors the 8 performance pads and the 4 pad-mode buttons of both sides with a color you pick in the Mod Menu (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet, white). The deck's dark, dimmed and animated pads keep their brightness and rhythm; only the hue changes.

It rewrites the pad LED frame before it reaches the panel. It does not patch the deck's code, change audio or use the network.
